tools.name: search_docs
tools.description:
Full-text search over the official AGILEX product documentation.

        Use this first for any question about AGILEX hardware: pinouts, CAN
        protocol details, baud rate, firmware upgrade, error codes, LED/beep
        meanings, installation, calibration, SDK usage.

        Args:

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description:
Read one documentation page as Markdown.

        Call this with a ``doc_id`` returned by ``search_docs`` (or a slug such as
        ``ymZimX7JLe``). Manuals are often 20k-60k characters, so this tool
        paginates: if the reply has ``truncated: true`` and a ``next_offset``,
        call again w

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description:
List documented pages, optionally inside one space.

        Use when the caller wants an inventory ("what manuals exist for ranger")
        rather than an answer.

        Args:
            space: optional space slug or name fragment.
            limit: 1-300, default 100.
            offset: pagi

tools.name: list_spaces
tools.description:
List the public documentation spaces with page counts.

        Call this when the caller is unsure which product family a document
        belongs to, or to explain coverage.

        Returns JSON: {count, spaces:[{space,name,docs,chars}]}.
